rejectedCandidate.disposition: retained as audit source; not approved for runtime assembly

review.finding: Accept the Meshy-normal variant. At identical geometry, material, lighting, and cameras it keeps coherent relief on the roof ribs, fascia, columns, foliage, and planters. Reject the dense-donor normal for runtime because it creates dark roof-panel halos and harsher patching on ribs and columns.
knownLimitations: The source retains fused and crumpled foliage in several garlands and planters.
The translucent roof panels retain visible surface-texture variation and are not pristine architectural glass.
The projection audit measures normalized surface proximity and approximate cage-ray coverage; it does not prove a clean tangent-space texture bake.
The dense-donor bake is retained for audit evidence, but its visible artifacts make it unsuitable for the runtime candidate.

tangentCorrection.reason: The original Blender export contained three referenced zero-length tangent rows.
tangentCorrection.method: Per-triangle UV derivative followed by Gram-Schmidt projection against the preserved exported split normal.

runtimeIntegration: authorized by this receipt but not performed by the candidate finisher
